reason.detail: Saturday's final NFL.com Week 8 injury report lists Seattle Seahawks left tackle Charles Cross out (ankle, did not participate all week); Cross started at left tackle for Seattle this season and Mike Macdonald said Josh Jones will start in his place, so the In The Trenches trench-out rule applies and the card makes no pick on this game.
